hooks.text: 战装、元素精华与精英军队组成英雄战略构筑
hooks.excerpt: Build devastating combinations by fusing powerful Wargears with Elemental Essences , while summoning elite troops to overwhelm the Evil Master's hordes.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 重建兵营、市场与城门平衡军事和经济
hooks.excerpt: Think you can hold the line? Bastion needs more than defense. Hordes are pushing. Will you rebuild the Knights Barracks , Antiques Market , or the Protection Gates ? Strike the right balance between the military and the economy.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 时间回溯让地理、任务、据点、敌人与Boss进化
hooks.excerpt: Time travel is your endgame. Every leap backward reveals harder challenges. Geography shifts. Quests, strategic points, and enemy types evolve. New bosses emerge.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
